community life. In partnership with the Massachusetts Office on Disability (MOD),

Eric Dionne o/b/o Margaret and William Gasperoni requests a Special Permit to construct a
covered front porch. The property is located at 49 COLE ST, BEVERLY, MA and is in the R15
zoning district.

Eric Dionne p/b/o Donald Macheca requests a Special Permit to construct a 15'x15' deck to the rear,
replacing the existing non-conforming 12'x15' deck. The property is located at 13 LONGFELLOW
ST, BEVERLY, MA and is in the R10 zoning district.

Thomas J. Alexander, Esq. o/b/o Beverly Tre LLC requests a Variance to construct a combined
residential (179 units) and commercial (2,600 sq.ft.) use structure having a sloped roof height of 46.5

single story 1,309 sq.ft. addition to the legally pre-existing nonconforming dental office. The use to be

R6 zoning district.

second level to existing garage to accommodate a fully insulated music studio. The property is located
at 17 VICTOR AVE, BEVERLY, MA and is in the R10 zoning district.

on the right side attic level of an existing two family home. The property is located at 6 GRANT ST,

Jared Gardiner o/b/o Marc and Mary Levesque requests a Variance to construct a covered
walkway connecting the recently completed addition to the new detached garage. The proposed
walkway will be approximately 16.6ft from the rear property line, where a 25-foot setback is required.
The property is located at 20 ATLANTIC AVE, BEVERLY, MA and is in the R6 zoning district.

Susan Browder requests a Variance to construct a new 14'x24' single-car attached garage with storage
above. The garage will be located approximately 5ft from the side property line due to the existing lot's
narrow 60.5ft width. The property is located at 19 WINTHROP AVE, BEVERLY, MA and is in the

Jennifer Mannke requests a Variance from Chapter 300, Article VI, Section 300-29 of the Beverly
